page: Microsoft Azure L48as_v5 is a member of the Lasv5 server family, utilizing an x86_64 AMD processor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration includes 11,519 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput disk operations. The server does not include any integrated GPUs and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high local NVMe SSD capacity and the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for storage-intensive and database workloads. The hardware profile offers a qualitative balance of high local storage density and substantial memory capacity, making it suitable for relational databases, NoSQL data stores, and transactional processing systems that require low-latency local disk access.
